# check_agent_status_tool

> Check the status of an agent run by passing its LlmAgentRun ID as `run_id` (the "runner id" returned by execute_agent_tool).

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `agents` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default) |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=check_agent_status_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Check the status of an agent run by passing its LlmAgentRun ID as `run_id`
(the "runner id" returned by execute_agent_tool).
It will return the LlmAgentRun record details which include
start_at: when it started
end_at: when it ended (if done)
successful: if it was successful
output: the last message from the agent
notified_partent: if this was a child agent if it has notified its parent
parent_llm_agent_run_id: Id of parent LlmAgentRun if you need to check the parent status

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | integer | no | LlmAgentRun ID to check (the "runner id" execute_agent_tool returned). Use THIS, not llm_agent_run_id, from inside an agent run. |
| `llm_agent_run_id` | integer | no | Deprecated alias of run_id for non-agent callers; ignored when run_id is present. |

## Example

```json
{"name": "check_agent_status_tool", "arguments": {"run_id": 48213}}
```

Returns the run record: `start_at`, `end_at`, `successful`, `output` (the agent's last
message), and the parent run id for child runs.

## Gotchas

- **Use `run_id`** (the id `execute_agent_tool` returned). `llm_agent_run_id` is a deprecated alias.
- **Poll with backoff.** Runs that read large conversations can take minutes; do not re-execute
  the agent while a run is open.
